title: Synthetic external event processing design
raw_text: Review a synthetic external event delivery design with normalization, one session per delivery identity, bounded retry, and an exhausted-failure handoff, without claiming unsupported runtime generation.
business_goal: Preserve a reviewed external event-processing boundary while stopping source generation until the generic runtime supports the event source, retry, and DLQ behavior.
current_process: Receive an opaque synthetic delivery at the external runtime boundary
Validate and normalize the delivery envelope
Create one logical session for the delivery identity
Apply bounded retry and hand exhausted failures to an external dead-letter boundary
